body: Today marks 19 years since Ye and 50 Cent put their albums head to head to see who would sell more first week 👀 50 Cent said he’d quit making music if he lost… On September 11, 2007, Kanye West released “Graduation” while 50 Cent dropped “Curtis,” turning release week into a showdown that had hip-hop fans picking sides. Ahead of the releases, 50 said that if Kanye sold more copies in the U.S., he would stop putting out solo albums. He clarified that he would still write music and work with other artists, but the statement added even more attention to their sales battle. When the first-week numbers arrived, “Graduation” debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with approximately 957,000 copies sold in the U.S., while “Curtis” landed at No. 2 with roughly 691,000. Together, they sold more than 1.6 MILLION albums in one week—before streaming counted toward album chart totals. 💿🤯 Kanye won the matchup, but 50 clearly didn’t follow through on retiring from solo releases 😭 Nineteen years later, which album are you playing first: “Graduation” or “Curtis”? 👀 📸: Kevin Winter / Getty Images 📸: Brad Barket / Getty Images

source_caption_text:
Today marks 19 years since Ye and 50 Cent put their albums head to head to see who would sell more first week 👀 50 Cent said he’d quit making music if he lost…

On September 11, 2007, Kanye West released “Graduation” while 50 Cent dropped “Curtis,” turning release week into a showdown that had hip-hop fans picking sides.

Ahead of the releases, 50 said that if Kanye sold more copies in the U.S., he would stop putting out solo albums. He clarified that he would still write music and work with other artists, but the statement added even more attention to their sales battle.

When the first-week numbers arrived, “Graduation” debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with approximately 957,000 copies sold in the U.S., while “Curtis” landed at No. 2 with roughly 691,000. Together, they sold more than 1.6 MILLION albums in one week—before streaming counted toward album chart totals. 💿🤯

Kanye won the matchup, but 50 clearly didn’t follow through on retiring from solo releases 😭

Nineteen years later, which album are you playing first: “Graduation” or “Curtis”? 👀

📸: Kevin Winter / Getty Images
